name: Subsonic Browse
author: Viboplr
description: Search, stream, and download across multiple Subsonic/Navidrome servers live — no indexing. A discovery layer for servers you visit, separate from your indexed Library.

permissionReasons.network:*: Reach the Subsonic and Navidrome servers you add, which can be at any address, to search, stream and download
permissionReasons.playback:read: Notice when a track from one of your servers is scrobbled, to report the play back to that server
permissionReasons.playback:control: Play tracks you find on your servers

viewHeader.subtitle: Search, stream and download across your Subsonic and Navidrome servers, live
